name: QuickBooks Online
description: QuickBooks Online as agent tools, via Intuit's OFFICIAL MCP server (github.com/intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server, Apache-2.0), pinned to commit 099351858ee696dbbeb00dc7ca8e3a86276d86bb. A thin HTTP bridge adapts its stdio MCP transport to Eesa's stateless JSON-RPC. Ships READ-ONLY by default: QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE/UPDATE/DELETE are set, so the container cannot create, update or delete anything in QuickBooks regardless of what is asked of it.
